channel.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
channel.desc: As the sun goes down in a quiet farm town, K9 Rico is deployed to track down a man accused of strangling his neighbor; meanwhile, K9 Clooney springs into action when a desperate suspect makes a bold, shocking move-stealing a police cruiser in a last-ditch attempt to escape; K9 Murphy teams up with the aviation unit, combining forces in a relentless search for a suspect who fled after leading officers on a nearly 100-mile chase.
